# Vendored terminal assets

These MIT-licensed packages are served locally and embedded into Tailgate. No CDN or frontend build step is required.

- `@xterm/xterm` 6.0.0: `xterm.js`, `xterm.css`, `xterm.LICENSE`.
- `@xterm/addon-fit` 0.11.0: `addon-fit.js`, `addon-fit.LICENSE`.

`versions.json` records the pinned npm tarball URLs and verified SHA-512 integrity. Original distribution files are retained unchanged.
